text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 2

An all-male panel that selected a man over you — also a man — can't plausibly have disadvantaged you on grounds of sex. Raising it would read as grasping and would undercut the parts of your case that are genuinely strong.

What is worth pursuing: your unanswered request for written reasons. Most municipalities have policy or statutory obligations around documenting competition decisions, and two weeks of silence is the real problem. Follow up in writing to HR, cite the original request date, and ask for the scoring criteria and how each finalist was rated.

If the posting required a master's or licence, the gap between stated requirements and the hire is your strongest line of inquiry.
